name: Table
description: Tabular data section in six shapes: pricing matrix (features x plans with a featured column), three compare cards with spec lists, flat or category-grouped datasheets, and a sortable data list (plain or zebra-striped) driven by column definitions plus JSON rows.
when_to_use: Structured data: pricing, technical specifications, project lists. Use Comparison when the framing is A-vs-B or before/after rather than plain data.
capabilities: pricing matrix with featured plan column, per-plan price/CTA, and true/false cells rendered as check/cross
compare cards with image, price, featured tag, and nested spec list
datasheet rows with property/value/unit/norm/note, optionally grouped by category
client-side sortable data list from column definitions (align, numeric, status badge, suffix) + free-form JSON rows
help tooltips on pricing feature rows

variants.description: Feature x plan matrix from pricing_plans[] + pricing_rows[]. Default.
3 option cards from compare_items[] with nested specs[].
Flat datasheet from specs_rows[] (+ specs_columns[] for multi-column keys).
Datasheet rows grouped under their specs_rows[].group headings.
Sortable data list from data_columns[] + data_rows[] (row_json).
Same data list with zebra striping.

breakpoints.mobile: Tables scroll horizontally; compare cards stack.

ai.prompt_summary: Table: tabular data section. Settings: variant (pricing|compare|specs|specs-grouped|data|data-striped), eyebrow, headline, intro (header centered for pricing/compare, left for specs/data — no alignment setting). Per variant: pricing_plans[] { label, price, per, note, featured, featured_tag, cta_label, cta_to } + pricing_rows[] { feature, help (tooltip), values (comma-separated, order matches plans, 'true'/'false' render as check/cross) }; compare_items[] { name, tagline, price, featured, featured_tag, cta_label, cta_to, image, specs[] { label, value } }; specs_columns[] { key, label } + specs_rows[] { group (specs-grouped), property, value, unit, norm, note }; data_columns[] { key, label, align (left|center|right), numeric, is_status, suffix } + data_rows[] { row_json (JSON object string, keys match data_columns) }.
ai.content_guidelines: Pricing: 3 plans, 5-8 feature rows, exactly one featured plan. Data lists: 4-6 columns, 5-10 rows. Keep cell values short; put detail into note/help fields.

field_hints.pricing_rows.values: Comma-separated in plan order; 'true'/'false' become check/cross icons.
field_hints.data_rows.row_json: One JSON object per row, e.g. {"ref":"PR-001","name":"Projekt","year":2026,"status":"In Planung"} — keys must match data_columns keys.
field_hints.data_columns.is_status: Renders the cell value as a status badge.
